description: Prepare an on-chain BlazePhoenix quote to run on YOUR OWN RPC. Returns the exact eth_call (Quoter address + calldata, as a ready JSON-RPC request and a curl line) plus a `request` object. Run the call on your node, then pass `request` and the result hex to decode_quote. This server performs no RPC.

amountIn.description: input amount in base units (wei-style integer string)

chain.description: base | eth | optimism | arbitrum | robinhood (or a chain id)

exact.description: true → previewPlanExact: every leg dry-run on its pool in this block; with recipient + userMinOut also calldata (exact mode applies a safety margin: userMinOut at or under exactOut less 50 bps). No tokens move from a holder, so a token that blocks or taxes its own transfer still quotes; simulate the swap from the holder to test that

in.description: input token — 0x address, or ETH / WETH / USDC / BZPX

out.description: output token — 0x address, or ETH / WETH / USDC / BZPX

recipient.description: optional 0x address; with it, decode_quote returns signable calldata

slippageBps.description: 0–5000 (default 50); how far under the quoted net output userMinOut may sit

userMinOut.description: minimum output, base units, from a price you trust; required for calldata, which enforces exactly this value

name: prepare_quote
title: Prepare an on-chain quote
